description: This file defines the ReadableCategory class, which extends CategoryEntity and implements Serializable. It includes properties related to category description, parent category, and product count, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ReadableCategory
classes.description: Represents a readable view of a category, including description, parent, and product count, with serialization capabilities.

methods.name: getProductCount
methods.description: Returns the number of products in the category.

methods.name: setProductCount
methods.description: Sets the product count for the category.
